### Parties

- Invite people into a party and follow your leader into whatever they launch
- Join by six character code, or invite straight from your friends list
- See what every member is in, and whether they are in the same server as you
- Follow automatically, or get asked first when you are already in a game
- Runs in the background, so an invite still reaches you when PhasmaStrap is closed

### Gallery

- Share screenshots from the Capture page
- Everything shared is looked at before it appears
- You are told when something you shared is approved, or taken down
- Crosshairs get a real preview instead of a broken image

### Cursors

- Any picture becomes your cursor, whatever it is named
- PNG, JPG, BMP, GIF, TIFF and ICO all work, and anything that is not a PNG is converted to one
- Cursor packs still apply in one click

### Developer tools

- The page is finished: FastFlag diff against Roblox defaults, live A/B toggle, proxy traffic log, log viewer, crash report bundler and the Studio plugin installer

### Fixes

- Joining a friend checks where they actually are first, instead of sending you to a server they already left
- Background processes are named in Task Manager, and stay out of Alt+Tab and the taskbar
- PhasmaStrap no longer claims it is already running when Roblox is closed
- The driver frame rate limit is on the Rendering page again, and two pages no longer fight over it
- The frame rate limit hotkeys are gone
- Every link points at the renamed repository
